Architecture Invariant: Nyaya implements all 8 layers of Agentic AI. A StateGraph (Layer 2) orchestrates specialized cognition (Layer 5) with
tooling (Layer 4), memory (Layer 6), and protocols (Layer 3), bounded by 4 human-in-the-loop governance gates and audit ledgers (Layer 8).
